title: Statutory Notice to Quit and Termination of Tenancy under Section 106 of the Transfer of Property Act, 1882
whenToUse: Use when terminating a monthly tenancy of immovable property by giving the mandatory 15-day notice to quit under Section 106 Transfer of Property Act, 1882 prior to instituting an eviction suit.
variantComparisonNote: Statutory notice to quit under Section 106 TPA. Distinct from civil suit for recovery of rent arrears and surety under Order VII CPC.
youWillNeed: Lease deed / rent agreement, rent payment counterfoils / bank receipts, property tax receipts proving landlord ownership.
legalBasis: Section 106, Section 111(h) Transfer of Property Act, 1882; Payal Vision Ltd. v. Radhika Choudhary (2012).
mandatoryStatutoryIngredients: Clear 15-day notice expiring with the end of the tenancy month
Clear identification of the demised premises under lease
Explicit determination of tenancy under Section 111(h) TPA, 1882
Demand for delivery of vacant physical possession and warning of mesne profits

particulars.label: Notice Date
particulars.description: Date of issuing notice to quit

particulars.label: Landlord / Owner Name
particulars.description: Full name of property owner / landlord

particulars.label: Demised Premises Address
particulars.description: Complete postal address of leased property

aiBlocks.title: Tenancy History & Monthly Rent
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Narrate creation of monthly tenancy of premises {{FACT:demised_property_address}} at agreed rent of ₹{{FACT:monthly_rent}}/- per month, and history of rental default or expiry of term.

aiBlocks.title: Termination of Tenancy under Section 106 TPA
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Formally determine and terminate the tenancy under Section 111(h) read with Section 106 of Transfer of Property Act, 1882, providing clear 15 days notice expiring with the end of the tenancy month.

aiBlocks.title: Demand for Vacant Possession & Mesne Profits
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Call upon {{FACT:tenant_name}} to hand over peaceful vacant possession on or before the expiry date, warning of damages/mesne profits and civil eviction suit.
